title: Guard block orbit advances by full blocks
statement: Let $b$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $j,r\in\mathbb N$ with $j\le |x|$ and $j+(b+1)r\le |x|$. For any Boolean output string $out$, iterating the guard machine's counter-loop orbit $r$ times from position $j$ in phase zero gives the configuration in phase zero at position $j+(b+1)r$, with output unchanged.
